name: visible
meaning: 0 hidden and non-solid (flags 0x800|0x400), 1 shown. Gates the sidle prompt.

name: seedPos
meaning: Filled by the Seed's reply to msg 0x3280 during the time-machine swap, then offset by g_timeMachineOffsetToPresent and used as the tree position.

name: visibleDirectly
meaning: VISIBLEDIRECTLY property (0 in Lvl-09, 1 in Lvl-10).
